name: card-blocks-and-sayable-close
why: The card is exactly five ordered bare-noun blocks and must end on a line the host can say out loud. A brief that ends on a fact is an unfinished handoff.
defends_against: An implementation that emits a well-written biography and stops, leaving the host with information and no action.

blocks.label: Who
blocks.text: Brad Feld. Foundry Group and Techstars, in from Boulder.

blocks.label: Now
blocks.text: Still posting most days on feld.com; twenty-seven posts since March.

blocks.label: Room
blocks.text: Fred Wilson is by the bar. Feld has cited Wilson in his own writing and they have argued the same thesis for twenty years.

blocks.label: Notice
blocks.text: He has run Random Day since about 2004: twenty minutes with any stranger who signs up. He once did a whole day of it in a Cookie Monster costume.

blocks.label: Say
blocks.text: You tell him Fred is here and that you have been meaning to ask how Random Day survived twenty years.
